newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.5 bln for week of Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.5 bln for week of Nov 4.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $2.529 billion in 85 offerings for the week of November 4, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $519 million in 46 offerings. The largest issue is a $135 million New York City new money and refunding taxable bond offering.
The busiest day of the week on the competitive calendar is Thursday, November 7, with 18 issues totaling $205 million.
Negotiated sales total $2.009 billion in 39 offerings. The largest issue is a $822 million New York City tax-exempt general obligation new money and refunding bond issue through Bear Stearns & Co.

An additional 11 negotiated deals totaling $281 million are on Reuter's day-to-day calendar for the week of November 4, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues depending on market conditions.
